paragraphs.source_en: There was a way to rescue Takechiyo—so far, the proposal sounded reasonable enough; but it was intolerable that, once rescued, Takechiyo would be sent to Sunpu as a hostage together with the families of the senior retainers. Would that not merely mean taking Takechiyo, who was a hostage of the Oda, and delivering him as a hostage to the Imagawa instead? It was even more frightening than his captivity with the Oda, for this time the families of the senior retainers would also be sent to Sunpu. Thereafter, with those hostages in its grasp, the Imagawa house could compel Okazaki’s senior retainers to serve again and again in the vanguard against the Oda clan.
